name: cliproxyapi-structured-authenticator-login-events
instr:
Add structured, correlated login progress and terminal outcomes so embedders can observe authentication without parsing provider-specific console text. Cover callback, device, manual-code, and pasted-token flows while preserving existing authentication and refresh behavior.

Every reported attempt starts with LoginEventStarted, ends with exactly one LoginEventSucceeded, LoginEventFailed, or LoginEventCancelled, and emits nothing afterward, even with concurrent attempts sharing a slow reporter. Manager.LoginWithEvents keeps attempt and provider identity consistent across events, LoginOutcome, and records; unknown providers fail terminally without invoking another authenticator. Codex, Claude, Antigravity, and Devin callback flows expose sanitized challenge, waiting, and distinguishable provider-specific transitions, while Kimi, xAI, and Codex device flows expose verification and authorization waiting under the same terminal law. Cancellation returns the context error, prevents persistence and later success, and affects only its own attempt. Failures retain unwrap-compatible causes and identify setup, challenge, validation, exchange, profile, record, or persistence stage. Successful acquisition reports persistence before success; persistence failure returns the unsaved record without a saved path.
